research_question: Can exact completed-session activity improve the reliability, persistence, or regime interpretation of the price-only ranker, after v1.6 rejected hard vetoes, global additive liquidity, and a fixed high-turnover VWAP reversal?

authority.reason: The repository already contains project-level work through 2026-07-27, so this is a preregistered candidate-specific retrospective comparison, not untouched production evidence.

v16_rejected_mechanisms: a global additive Ridge containing all seven exact-liquidity ranks
a fixed rule that strengthens close-versus-VWAP reversal as turnover shock rises
prior_result_binding.not_inferred: v1.6 does not establish that exact activity is useless as pairwise reliability, price-memory weighting, regime state, or training-label reliability.
prior_result_binding.v17_family_hypothesis: Exact D-1 activity is more useful as reliability, persistence, and regime context for a price signal than as unconditional mean alpha or a hard cash veto.

price_warmup.purpose: price history only; monthly rows never receive synthetic liquidity

source_contract.failure_rule: A missing or extra source, filename/date mismatch, byte-count mismatch, SHA-256 mismatch, parser-version mismatch, parser rejection, duplicate date-code row, or schedule mismatch aborts the complete family. No proxy, stub, or price-derived replacement is permitted for unavailable activity.

periods.fit_schedule: monthly expanding; every model and OOF score for a month uses labels ending no later than the preceding month

point_in_time_contract.latest_predictor_source: the immediately preceding completed official session
point_in_time_contract.target_outcome_use: The outcome-free one-slot score ledger is canonicalised and hashed before selection-date open-to-close outcomes are joined by date and code.
point_in_time_contract.cash_rule: A date with no common eligible score row, no complete frozen C00 top-two pair, a missing selected code, or a missing observed target outcome is cash with zero gross return and zero cost; no lower-ranked or replacement-model substitution is allowed.
point_in_time_contract.tie_break: higher score, then security code ascending

common_universe.price_rule: the v1.6 price-score eligibility rule using only D-1-known membership, coverage, and continuous history
common_universe.activity_rule: 20 consecutive completed daily rows through D-1 with positive close, volume, turnover, VWAP, and trading unit and a stable trading unit
common_universe.rank_transform: average-tie cross-sectional rank mapped to [-1, 1] on the registered eligible source-date cross-section
common_universe.missing_value_rule: G0 price features use the frozen fold-median plus missing indicator. Registered exact-activity features must be finite. VP07's explicit invalid zero-range row and AT10 rows lacking all four required prior turnover ranks are excluded from that candidate only and are never replaced by a proxy.

controls.role: matched control for every candidate except PAIR01

controls.top_set: the frozen monthly C00 top two
controls.training_pairs: one OOF C00 top-two pair per prior date with two observed unequal returns, represented in both orientations with total date weight one; an equal-return date has no binary preference and is excluded identically from PAIR00 and PAIR01
controls.preprocess: fold median with missing indicator, then StandardScaler
controls.slot: one of the frozen two; no outsider

controls.role: diagnostic only; excluded from the family and winner rule

candidates.hypothesis: Exact activity can resolve which of C00's two strongest price candidates is more reliable without globally disturbing the profitable shoulder.
candidates.top_set: freeze the monthly C00 top two before any activity value is consulted
candidates.training_pairs: expanding-month OOF C00 top-two pairs; each historical month's C00 is trained only through the preceding month; one pair per date with two observed unequal returns, in both orientations; equal-return dates are excluded identically from PAIR00 and PAIR01
candidates.features: C00 model-score difference plus differences of all seven exact_liquidity_rank_features
candidates.preprocess: fold median with missing indicator, then StandardScaler

candidates.hypothesis: Price moves supported by more traded value carry different information from equal-day price averages.
features: tw_mean_k = sum(turnover[t] * OC_return_pct[t]) / sum(turnover[t]) for k in {5,20}
tw_minus_equal_k = tw_mean_k - mean(OC_return_pct[t]) for k in {5,20}
candidates.model: G0 plus four registered features; daily-rank Ridge alpha=1; date-equal weight

candidates.hypothesis: The market's turnover-weighted multi-day cost basis and its migration contain state information absent from one-day VWAP deviation.
features: AVWAP_k = sum(turnover[t]) / sum(volume[t]) for k in {5,20}
candidates.model: G0 plus two registered features; daily-rank Ridge alpha=1; date-equal weight

candidates.hypothesis: A large price move per yen of turnover is fragile price impact and should reverse.
candidates.model: deterministic; no fit and no direction search

candidates.hypothesis: The mapping from price history to return rank differs between positive and nonpositive issuer activity shocks.
candidates.model: two separate G0 daily-rank Ridge experts, alpha=1 and date-equal weight; route each score row by its D-1 state

candidates.hypothesis: A persistent activity regime and an isolated one-day shock change the meaning of close-versus-VWAP pressure in different ways.
features: cross-sectional xrank of sustained and isolated
candidates.model: G0 plus four registered features; daily-rank Ridge alpha=1; date-equal weight

candidates.hypothesis: The persistence of close location relative to VWAP and daily range separates durable demand from a one-day deviation.
features: turnover-weighted p over trailing 5 and 20 sessions, then xrank each
candidates.zero_range_rule: p=0 only when high=low and close is numerically equal to VWAP; any other zero-range row is invalid and removed for VP07, never proxied or imputed
candidates.model: G0 plus two registered features; daily-rank Ridge alpha=1; date-equal weight

candidates.hypothesis: Labels from sessions with more repeatedly traded lots are more reliable training observations, even when the score universe is unchanged.
candidates.reliability: median(volume / trading_unit) over D-20:D-1, ranked to a strictly positive within-date percentile
candidates.weight: normalise reliability percentiles so every training date has total weight one
candidates.model: G0 daily-rank Ridge alpha=1; no activity feature in the predictor

candidates.hypothesis: Market-wide concentration and VWAP-pressure breadth change how issuer momentum should be interpreted.
candidates.features: pressure_breadth and turnover_HHI each multiplied by signed xrank_close_momentum_5 and signed xrank_close_momentum_20
candidates.model: G0 plus four registered interactions; daily-rank Ridge alpha=1; date-equal weight

candidates.hypothesis: A security gaining market attention relative to its own recent cross-sectional activity rank changes the meaning of VWAP pressure.
candidates.availability_rule: All four issuer turnover ranks for D-5 through D-2 must be observed in addition to D-1. A row lacking that history is ineligible for AT10 only and is never imputed or proxied.
candidates.model: G0 plus two registered features; daily-rank Ridge alpha=1; date-equal weight

evaluation.family_member_rule: All ten candidates remain in the family even if failed, cash, or sequence-identical. Controls and C02 are not family members.
evaluation.cost_interpretation: fixed sensitivity haircuts, not measured spread, slippage, or fill cost

bootstrap.candidate_seed_rule: random_state + zero-based candidate order index, yielding 20260804 through 20260813

evaluation.winner_rule: If no candidate passes every gate, reject all. Otherwise choose the highest Bonferroni paired lower bound, then highest top-four-days-removed net40, then candidate id ascending. Nominate at most one retrospective research candidate; never promote production or enable orders.

required_tests: exact ordered ten-candidate and matched-control registry
protocol, input-lock, and parser hashes fail closed
same-day source mutation cannot change the same target-date features or score ledger
future mutation cannot change any earlier feature or score
row order leaves semantic scores unchanged
nonconsecutive history, nonpositive activity, and trading-unit changes fail closed
PAIR01 and PAIR00 can choose only from the frozen C00 top two
every pair-training score is expanding-month OOF and every label precedes the score month
equal-return historical top-two pairs are excluded identically from PAIR00 and PAIR01
VP07 zero-range behavior matches the registered rule
AT10 requires four observed prior turnover ranks and never proxies a missing rank
outcome-free score ledger is hashed before selection outcomes are joined
production promotion, production model change, and orders remain false
stop_rule: After this protocol, source lock, runner, audit, and tests are remotely committed together, parse the 79 replay outcomes and run the ten candidates exactly once. Do not add, remove, or alter candidates, formulas, universes, parameters, costs, gates, controls, or winner rules after any replay outcome is parsed.
